relations.subject: Liang Qichao
relations.evidence: Liang's works were strongly influenced by the Japanese political scholar Katō Hiroyuki, who used methods of social Darwinism to promote the statist ideology in Japanese society.

relations.subject: Liang Qichao
relations.evidence: After the failure of constitutional reform, Liang founded the literary journal New Fiction as part of his effort to encourage intellectuals to use fiction for pedagogical and political purposes.

relations.subject: Liang Qichao
relations.evidence: Liang was head of the Translation Bureau and oversaw the training of students who were learning to translate Western works into Chinese.
